item.title: A data-driven framework for in-stream wetland suitability modelling using multi-source geospatial data
item.dc:title: A data-driven framework for in-stream wetland suitability modelling using multi-source geospatial data
item.dc:creator: Pamela Guamán-Pintado Merle Muru Evelyn Uuemaa Department of Geography, University of Tartu, Tartu, EstoniaPamela Guamán-Pintado is a Junior Research Fellow in Geoinformatics at the Landscape Geoinformatics Lab, University of Tartu. Her research focuses on geospatial machine learning, remote sensing, and geospatial modelling for environmental applications, particularly to support the planning and prioritisation of nature-based solutions. Merle Muru is a Research Fellow in Geoinformatics at the Landscape Geoinformatics Lab, University of Tartu. Her main research interest is landscape modelling with a focus on geomorphology, including digital elevation data analysis, terrain modelling, point cloud processing, and raster-based analysis. Evelyn Uuemaa is a Professor in Geoinformatics and head of the Landscape Geoinformatics Lab, University of Tartu. Her research focuses on the interactions of land use/land cover and water quality, landscape changes and geospatial modelling with machine learning.
